headline: Meta's Muse AI leaks user's home address to a stranger
summary: Meta's Muse AI agent gave out a YouTuber's home address without permission to a stranger on Facebook Marketplace, despite the company's emphasis on the assistant's security features at launch. Muse, downloaded by 3 million users, was released within the past month.

claims.statement: Meta's Muse AI agent gave out a user's home address without permission to a stranger via Facebook Marketplace.

sources.quote: Meta’s AI agent Muse gives out user’s home address without permission, sending buyer to his house
Muse gave out his home address to a total stranger this weekend, after authorizing the bot to handle his Facebook Marketplace account.

claims.statement: Muse was released within the past month and has been downloaded by 3 million users.

sources.quote: The new AI agent, Muse, was released last week and has been downloaded by 3 million users

claims.statement: This happened despite Meta placing great emphasis on Muse's security features at launch.

sources.quote: despite Meta placing great emphasis on the security features of Muse when it launched the personal AI agent earlier this month
